description: This file is a snippet of configuration for ARM architecture tuning within a Yocto Project build environment. It defines specific tuning features, compiler flags, and architecture overrides for different ARM variants, including ARMv4 and its sub-variants for both Little and Big Endian modes.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: A utility function used to determine if a specific feature or string is present within a variable, with support for conditional expressions in the build configuration.
